fish-trout.name: Trout
fish-trout.description: A speckled river trout, pink along its side. Likes cold, fast water. (Fishing mod)

fish-perch.name: Perch
fish-perch.description: A striped perch with orange fins. Found round weeds in lakes and slow water. (Fishing mod)

fish-carp.name: Carp
fish-carp.description: A heavy golden carp. Loves warm, still water and muddy bottoms. (Fishing mod)

fish-catfish.name: Catfish
fish-catfish.description: A whiskered catfish. Bites best after dark. (Fishing mod)

fish-sunfish.name: Sunfish
fish-sunfish.description: A little round sunfish, orange-bellied. Lives in calm, weedy shallows. (Fishing mod)

fish-golden_carp.name: Golden carp
fish-golden_carp.description: A rare golden carp that shimmers in the light. (Fishing mod)

fish-moonlit_catfish.name: Moonlit catfish
fish-moonlit_catfish.description: A rare catfish with a faint silvery glow, only seen on bright moonlit nights. (Fishing mod)

junk-hat.name: Old sun hat
junk-hat.description: A soggy straw sun hat fished out of the water. It has ear holes. (Fishing mod)

junk-can.name: Tin can
junk-can.description: A rusty old tin can, fished out of the water. (Fishing mod)

junk-horseshoe.name: Lost horseshoe
junk-horseshoe.description: An iron horseshoe somepony lost in the water. (Fishing mod)

fishing-log.name: Angler's Log
fishing-log.description: Every fish you've caught, your best sizes and where you found them. Hold it and click to read. (Fishing mod)
